info.name: Smart Teller Gateway (STM middleware)
info.description:
Every /stm/v1 operation of the Smart Teller Core Banking API Specification, ordered as the customer journeys, plus the portal API.

1. Start the middleware (demo profile) and set `baseUrl` if it is not http://localhost:8080.
2. Run folder **0 · Setup** first: it registers a demo kiosk and stores the device token.
3. Run any journey folder, or the whole collection in the Collection Runner. Requests save IDs (sessionId, applicationId, orderId, …) for the next ones.

Folders 1, 2 and 4 work once per database (the customer then exists / has the card). OTP is always 123456 in the demo profile. Payloads and rules: docs/API.md.
